tasks.label: deploy
tasks.detail: Build, rsync to Deck and restart plugin_loader
tasks.command: DECK_IP=${config:deckip} DECK_PORT=${config:deckport} DECK_USER=${config:deckuser} DECK_PASS=${config:deckpass} DECK_KEY=${config:deckkey} ${workspaceFolder}/deploy.sh deploy

tasks.label: restart-decky
tasks.command: DECK_IP=${config:deckip} DECK_PORT=${config:deckport} DECK_USER=${config:deckuser} DECK_PASS=${config:deckpass} DECK_KEY=${config:deckkey} ${workspaceFolder}/deploy.sh restart

tasks.label: zip
tasks.detail: Package a store-style installable zip into out/

tasks.label: settingscheck
tasks.command: test -f ${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/settings.json || (cp ${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/defsettings.json ${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/settings.json && echo 'Created .vscode/settings.json with defaults - edit deckip/deckpass then run again' && exit 1)
